name: braid
goal: Build source evidence, join it, fan out to a draft and check, then join those results.

specification.goal: Build source evidence, join it, fan out to a draft and check, then join those results.

functional_requirements.description: The two source lines are extracted in source order.
The source line count is classified.
The published note contains the consolidated facts and check result.
acceptance: published.md includes alpha,beta / 2 and Checked: PASS

nfrs.description: Each branch writes separate accepted evidence before publication.
acceptance: seed, extraction, classification, draft, check, and published artifacts remain separately inspectable

done_when: seed.txt contains the immutable source note
contract.shared_reason: One accepted source note supplies the extraction, classification, and resulting publication.

ready_when: the accepted source note is available
done_when: extract.txt records the source lines in order

argv: import json; from pathlib import Path; Path('classify.json').write_text(json.dumps({'lines': len(Path('seed.txt').read_text().splitlines())}))

ready_when: the accepted source note is available
done_when: classify.json records the source line count

argv: import json; from pathlib import Path; extract=Path('extract.txt').read_text(); facts=json.loads(Path('classify.json').read_text()); assert facts == {'lines': 2}; Path('consolidated.txt').write_text(extract + ' / ' + str(facts['lines']))

ready_when: both accepted source branches are available
done_when: consolidated.txt records the checked combined fact
contract.shared_reason: The draft must use both independent source interpretations, so their evidence joins here.

argv: from pathlib import Path; Path('draft.md').write_text('# Draft\n' + Path('consolidated.txt').read_text() + '\n')

ready_when: the accepted consolidated fact is available
done_when: draft.md contains the consolidated source fact

argv: from pathlib import Path; assert Path('consolidated.txt').read_text() == 'alpha,beta / 2'; Path('check.txt').write_text('PASS\n')

ready_when: the accepted consolidated source fact is available
done_when: check.txt records a passing source-fact check
contract.shared_reason: One check verifies the two requirements that meet in the consolidated fact.

argv: from pathlib import Path; assert Path('check.txt').read_text() == 'PASS\n'; Path('published.md').write_text(Path('draft.md').read_text() + 'Checked: PASS\n')

ready_when: the accepted draft and source-fact check are available
contract.shared_reason: Publication joins the drafted note with the independent source check and preserves all branch evidence.
